subject: Network switchover acceptance and health sampling
messages:
From: Cara Liao <cara@starlite.io>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ACME Infra <infra@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final acceptance criteria before network switchover

Hi Laura —

We're green to proceed with the private VPC switchover window tomorrow at 02:00 UTC, but infra needs a final confirmation that the post-cutover smoke sampling and runbook playback are acceptable to Redwood. Specifically:

- Will Redwood accept the minimal acceptance criteria (see bullets below) as the formal gate to mark the switch as "in-service"?
- Can you confirm who will own the 30-minute live validation window and who gets the escalation if one of the checks fails?

Minimal acceptance checklist request (requested by ACME):
- Control-plane connectivity (API endpoints reachable) from two regions
- Overlay networking: peering and ACL propagation validated
- Simple inference smoke: 3x 32-token prompts across canary model (p99 latency < 300ms)
- Telemetry/trace sampling present in Redwood Console and exported to our SIEM
- KV-prefix warmup and cache hit rate > 60% for prefix set

We also need a brief post-cutover sampling report (CSV) with timestamps, test IDs, and pass/fail. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Cara
Ops Lead, Starlite Payments

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Cara Liao <cara@starlite.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ACME Infra <infra@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 19:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final acceptance criteria before network switchover

Cara — thanks for the clear checklist. We can accept that as the formal gate with the following clarifications and owner assignments: 

- Ownership: Redwood owns the 30-minute live validation window and will hand off a signed acceptance to ACME infra at the end. Laura Bennett (me) is overall cutover owner; Marissa will run the smoke harness; Mateo will produce sample CSVs and traces.
- Acceptance tweaks: p99 latency target for the canary model to be measured on the Redwood Dedicated endpoint (not the external LB) — we'll document the test point in the runbook.
- Escalation: Karthik will be primary on-call for infra escalations; Marissa will raise the rollback play if the KV warmup fails repeatedly.

Attached: onprem_switchover_runbook_v2.pdf — sections 2.3 and 4.1 include the exact commands and healthchecks.

Quick smoke plan (short):
1) Pre-cutover: netdiag from two probe hosts (icmp, route traces, mTLS handshake)
2) Cutover: controlled route switch at 02:00 UTC, enable prefix-level caching\3) Post-cutover (0–30m window):
   - API reachability check (3 regions, 3 samples each)
   - Canary inference (3 x 32-token prompts, 10-second spacing)
   - KV cache warmup (prefix list) & check hit-rate
   - Telemetry flush and sample trace export (initial 100 traces)

Please confirm ACME is OK with the measurement points and that you'll accept the CSV template we send back after sampling.

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Production Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onprem_switchover_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Cara Liao <cara@starlite.io>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 02:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final acceptance criteria before network switchover

Thanks — I can run the smoke harness overnight and will follow the runbook steps. Notes for the team: 

- I'll run netdiag suite at 01:30 UTC from probe-a and probe-b; expect ~60s for full traces.
- Canary runner will be warmed with a synthetic keyset before cutover to ensure KV warmup.
- If p99 spikes above 350ms for the canary model twice within the 15m sampling bucket, I'll trigger rollback and notify Laura and Karthik.

Planned artifacts to attach after the window: smoke_results_20270711.csv (timestamps + test IDs), netdiag_trace_07011.txt (raw traces), and a short runbook-playback.log.

Marissa
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Cara Liao <cara@starlite.io>, ACME Infra <infra@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-cutover sampling report: smoke_results_20270711.csv attached

Laura/Team / Cara —

We completed the 30-minute validation window starting 02:00 UTC. High level summary: all green except a transient telemetry export delay between 02:04–02:07 UTC. Details below and attachments.

Summary (pass/fail):
- Control-plane connectivity: PASS (3/3 regions, API endpoints reachable)
- Overlay networking (peer + ACL): PASS (propagation confirmed)
- Canary inference: PASS (3 prompts, p99 = 248ms, avg = 112ms)
- Telemetry export: PARTIAL (trace sampling recorded; SIEM ingest delayed, resolved after force-flush at 02:08)
- KV cache warmup: PASS (initial hit-rate 67% after warmup)

Attached artifacts: smoke_results_20270711.csv (CSV), netdiag_trace_07011.txt (raw traceroutes). The CSV columns: test_id, timestamp_utc, probe, test_type, target, result, latency_ms, notes

Sample row from CSV:
SMK-023,2027-07-12T02:02:14Z,probe-a,canary_infer,canary-v1,PASS,241,"ok"

Telemetry note: SIEM ingestion saw a 3-minute lag due to an exporter backpressure. We forced a flush and verified the traces landed; export latency now within expected bounds. Karthik is following up on exporter queue sizing and will propose a knob for the console.

Attachments: smoke_results_20270711.csv (1.1KB), netdiag_trace_07011.txt (12KB)

Mateo Alvarez
Platform Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jul 11, 2027 at 02:30 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Cara — thanks for the clear checklist. We can accept that as the formal gate with the following clarifications and owner assignments:...

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final acceptance criteria before network switchover

Laura / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for owning validation. We accept the post-cutover report. Small ask: can you add the CSV to the shared Drive folder and post a short note in the JIRA OPS-4271 so our security team can cross-check trace IDs? Otherwise we're good to mark the switchover complete on our side.

I'll close the ACME change ticket after I see the Drive link. Appreciate the team effort.

—Cara
Ops Lead, Starlite Payments
